config.title: Photography Museums in Berlin - FAQ
config.subtitle: Opening hours, prices and the best order for Fotografiska, C/O Berlin, the Museum für Fotografie and Camera Work.

items.q: What are the best photography museums in Berlin?
items.a: **Fotografiska** in the old Tacheles building in Mitte, **C/O Berlin** in the Amerika Haus and the **Museum für Fotografie** with the Helmut Newton Foundation, both next to Zoologischer Garten station. The **Camera Work** gallery on Kantstraße is a free fourth stop.

items.q: Which photography museum in Berlin is open late?
items.a: **Fotografiska**, open every day until 23:00 with last entry at 22:00. C/O Berlin closes at 20:00, and the Museum für Fotografie at 19:00, or 20:00 on Thursdays.

items.q: Which Berlin photography museums are open on Monday?
items.a: **Fotografiska** and **C/O Berlin**. The Museum für Fotografie and Camera Work are closed on Mondays.

items.q: How much do photography museums in Berlin cost?
items.a: Fotografiska and C/O Berlin charge **15 euros**, the Museum für Fotografie **12 euros**, and Camera Work is free. C/O Berlin is free up to and including age 18 and the Museum für Fotografie under 18. Prices checked on 11 October 2026.

items.q: Is the Helmut Newton Foundation open in November?
items.a: Until 15 November. The Museum für Fotografie, which houses the foundation, is **closed from 16 November to 2 December 2026** for building work, and new Newton shows open in early December.

items.q: Can I combine C/O Berlin and the Museum für Fotografie?
items.a: Yes. They are a **4-minute walk** apart near Zoologischer Garten, and a same-day ticket from one takes **2 euros off** the full ticket at the other. The Museumspass Berlin covers the Museum für Fotografie but not C/O Berlin or Fotografiska.
